folder.help: Enter the full path to your existing project folder. Claude Code will analyze its structure and generate epics and user stories.

github.help: Paste a GitHub repository URL. Arij clones it into its own workspace, then Claude Code analyzes the codebase and generates epics and user stories.
github.invalid: Not a GitHub repository. Use https://github.com/owner/repo, git@github.com:owner/repo.git, or owner/repo.
github.tokenHint: Private repositories use the GitHub token from Settings.
